description: Eight signals each passed or replaced by a mute voltage, in 6HP, switched by a button per section and an All button

params.text: Sets the voltage a muted output carries, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, at 0V in the centre
Mutes all eight sections at once, or unmutes them, according to the All-button mode on the menu
Makes the button beside it a toggle, one press muting and the next unmuting, in place of a mute that lasts while the button is held
Mutes that section while it is held, or until the next press when its latch button is on

inputs.text: Adds its voltage to the mute value knob, so a muted output follows this jack offset by the knob
The signal that section passes; with the IN jack of section 1 left empty every unmuted output reads 0V, whatever is patched here, which the maker's tooltip does not say

outputs.text: Carries that section's input while it is unmuted and the mute voltage while it is muted

notes: patching the IN jack of section 1 is what starts the chain: sections below it read the nearest input above them, and with section 1 empty none of them read anything
menu: All-button mode: All OFF, All ON, Toggle ALL — chooses what the All button does to the eight mute buttons
Set mute-buttons 1-8: Latched, Unlatched — sets all eight latch buttons at once
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
